notes.title: Anetona v1.1 Update!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38294902/ebb6b3279349c08b3de79bce9f8b4911cfe9d3d3.png[/img]

Welcome to the Anetona v1.1 update!


Without any hesitation, let us begin!

Here is what is new:

-Added in an new item called Amulet of Hope. It will fill up
that empty equipment slot nice for you and increases all stats slightly.

-Added in two more levels before the final boss with a new enemy type
and new boss.

-Changed the sky level a little bit.

-You have access to more skills than just 5 and your best skill at level 15.
You have to equip the new ones you learn.

Bug Fixes

-Fixed some issues including buggy HP bars.

-Unfortunatly Controller support isn't there yet, but you can use Steam's
built in application to map controller support for the game manually.

That is all for now, continue to enjoy Anetona and for those of you who are new,
good luck because it's a difficult experience!
